meta.title: Account manager at a B2B software company
meta.blurb: Looks after about forty customer accounts: renewals, check-ins and expansion.

opportunities.why: You get a high volume of Gmail and reply directly to similar customer requests for numbers, invoices and meeting times.
opportunities.firstStep: Turn on the inbox summary each morning and copy its action items into your to-do list for a week.
opportunities.failureMode: Summaries miss the one message that mattered, so important senders still need a rule that flags them.

opportunities.taskName: Write call notes into the CRM
opportunities.quote: I write notes after each customer call into Salesforce by hand
opportunities.why: You write notes by hand after each customer call on Zoom and turn them into CRM records.
opportunities.firstStep: Turn on the meeting recap for one recurring meeting and compare its action list with your own for two weeks.
opportunities.failureMode: Recaps assign actions to the wrong person when names are not said aloud.

rules.name: Task is in the task map
Quoted evidence appears word for word in the visitor's answers
Pattern is in the catalog and every required signal was recorded
Tool is listed on the pattern, with a working link checked within the limit
Hours figures are the ones code computed
A working-habit suggestion carries no hours unless the catalog supplies a share

transcript.question: About how many emails do you go through for "Triage the inbox" each day?
transcript.answer: About 60 a day, so I'd say 50-100.

transcript.question: For "Triage the inbox", who do the emails mostly come from, and where do they go afterward?
transcript.answer: Mostly customers asking for usage numbers, invoices or meeting times; I reply to them directly.

transcript.question: About how many "Customer calls" do you have in a typical week?
For "Customer calls", how do the calls get booked, and where do notes or follow-ups go afterward?
options: Customers book; notes go to Salesforce
I schedule by email; notes go to Salesforce
Manager assigns; notes go to team
Calendar invites; follow-up email to customer
transcript.answer: I schedule by email; notes go to Salesforce.

transcript.question: About how many call notes do you write into the CRM in a typical week?
transcript.answer: Probably 5-10 a week, since I write notes after each customer call into Salesforce by hand.
